_note: Every entry of the PPQS 'List of pesticides which are banned, refused registration and restricted in use' (owner download from ppqs.gov.in, 2026-11-06), page by page. effective_from is the notification date printed for the entry; where the list prints none it is the list's own date. Kinds: banned (I.A, I.B, and III entries that ban all agricultural use), withdrawn (I.C, DDT in agriculture), refused (II), restricted (III, crop- or user-specific). Synonyms only where the list prints another name or spelling. A 'restricted' entry with no crops never blocks a citrus row (it limits who or which formulation, not the crop).

III Restricted: pest control operations only by Govt. / Govt. undertakings / pest control operators under expert supervision, except 15% 12 g and 6% tablets (RC circular 21-09-1984; G.S.R. 371(E) 20 May 1999); 10/20-tablet 3 g tube packs banned (S.O. 677(E) 17 July 2001)

III Restricted: all other formulations of Carbofuran except Carbofuran three percent Encapsulated granule (CG) along with the crop labels may be stopped from use (S.O. 4294(E) dated 3rd October, 2023)
III Restricted: Chlorpyriphos is banned for use in Ber, Citrus and Tobacco (S.O. 4294(E) dated 3rd October, 2023)

III Restricted: Cypermethrin 3% Smoke Generator only through Pest Control Operators, not by the General Public (Delhi High Court WP(C) 10052 of 2009 dated '1407- 2009' as printed; LPA-429/2009 dated 08-09-2009)
III Restricted: the use of Dazomet is not permitted on Tea (S.O.3006(E) dated 31st Dec, 2008)

III.7 DDT (printed 'Dicohlro Diphenyl Trichloroethane (DDT)'): use in Agriculture is withdrawn; only under expert Govt. supervision in very special circumstances (S.O.378(E) 26 May 1989). Public health use capped (S.O.295(E) 8 March 2006)
III Restricted: Dimethoate is banned for use in fruits and vegetables that are consumed as raw food items (S.O. 4294(E) dated 3rd October, 2023)
III.9 The use of Fenitrothion is banned in Agriculture except for locust control in scheduled desert area and public health (S.O.706(E) dated 03rd May, 2007)
III Restricted: banned for use on Sorghum, Pea, Soybean, Castor, Sunflower, Bhindi, Brinjal, Cauliflower, Radish, Turnip, Tomato, Apple, Mango and Grape (S.O. 4294(E) dated 3rd October, 2023)
III Restricted: Mancozeb is banned for use on Guava, Jowar and Tapioca (S.O. 4294(E) dated 3rd October, 2023)

III Restricted: only by Govt. / Govt. undertakings / Govt. organizations / pest control operators under the strict supervision of Govt. experts (G.S.R.371(E) dated 20th May, 1999 and earlier RC decision)

III Restricted: banned for use on vegetables (S.O.1482(E) dated 10th Oct, 2005); 36% SL to be discontinued, its registrations cancelled after one year, existing stock only till expiry (S.O. 4294(E) dated 3rd October, 2023)
III Restricted: Oxyfluorfen is banned for use on Potato and Groundnut (S.O. 4294(E) dated 3rd October, 2023)
III Restricted: Quinalphos is banned for use on Jute, Cardamom and Sorghum (S.O. 4294(E) dated 3rd October, 2023)
III.16 Registration, import, manufacture, formulation, transport, sale and all uses except use in wheat prohibited and completely banned from 8th August, 2018 (S.O 3951(E) dated 8th August, 2018)
